title: Words to an actor on a built set
pitch: A description in. A character sheet, a textured mesh, a rig, motion, a real-scale set and a directed shot of the character in it out.
why: This is the longest chain we can run today, and every join matters. The picture check clears the sheet, TRELLIS.2 builds the mesh, SkinTokens rigs it, Kimodo writes the motion from words, World Kit builds the street, and H3 follows the exact depth of the Blender shot.

fields.label: Who it is
fields.default: a courier in his forties, broad shoulders, close-cropped grey hair, a rust-orange canvas work jacket, dark green trousers, heavy brown boots

tips: Words only: this chain has no photo input by design, and the sheet must pass the picture check.
Say the clothes and colours you would know from far away.

steps.label: Character sheet
steps.does: Draws the invented adult once, front on, and runs the picture check over it.

steps.label: Mesh, rig, motion

clips.name: walk
clips.text: a person walks forward at a relaxed pace

clips.name: wave
clips.text: a person stands and waves with the right hand

steps.does: TRELLIS.2 builds the mesh from the sheet, SkinTokens rigs it, Kimodo writes each motion from words, and Blender assembles one file.

steps.label: The set

source.brief: a quiet downtown street at golden hour with old brick shopfronts

steps.does: A real-scale street, built in Blender from a brief.

steps.label: The shot

shot.name: The courier walks
shot.prompt: A courier in a rust-orange work jacket walks down a quiet brick street toward the camera at golden hour. The shop signs are plain painted boards with no lettering.

steps.does: Blender renders the blocked shot, and H3 follows its exact depth.
